title: Theoretical physicists at S4 had exhausted gravity approaches

tellings.quote: >> Oh, for sure. Okay. I think they were exhausted by him. And I think they they kept going over that road and never got anywhere.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at S-4, a secret Nevada site, in 1988 and 1989, talks with podcast host Jesse Michels about the scientists there. He says the theoretical physicists had kept trying the same gravity-based ideas to explain how the craft worked and never got anywhere. The talk brings in the researchers Eric Weinstein and Eric Davis, and the point is that, as he tells it, the craft defeated the experts trying to understand them.
